# Libre Computer GPIO Pinout

> Interactive GPIO pinout and pinmux reference for Libre Computer single-board computers.

Part of Libre Computer (https://libre.computer/llms.txt). Every board page carries its pin table as HTML.

## Boards

- [Tritium H3](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/all-h3-cc-h3/)
- [Tritium H5](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/all-h3-cc-h5/)
- [Alta](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-a311d-cc/)
- [Alta Compute Module](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-a311d-cm/)
- [La Frite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac/)
- [Das Frite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s805x-ac-v2/)
- [Solitude](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905d3-cc/)
- [Solitude Compute Module](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905d3-cm/)
- [Le Potato](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc/)
- [Sweet Potato](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/aml-s905x-cc-v2/)
- [Renegade](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3328-cc/)
- [Renegade Elite](https://gpio.hardware.libre.computer/roc-rk3399-pc/)
